description: Downloads through qBittorrent's Web API (4.x and 5.x).

settings.url_help: For example http://qbittorrent:8080. How its folders look to Reelix is set in "How it names the folders" in this card.

checks.off: Nothing can be downloaded until qBittorrent is connected.
checks.login_refused: qBittorrent refused the user name or password
checks.paused: Downloads are paused: Reelix sends no more logins until the password changes or you test the connection.
checks.banned: qBittorrent has banned Reelix's address after failed logins
checks.banned_impact: Downloads are paused. Wait, or restart qBittorrent, then test the connection.
